cases.title: Exact mapping
cases.procedure: Verify the sole route uses PC-32473-C-8268ea3e37 and LNX-REF-PC-32473-C-8268ea3e37; PORTRAIT-008 is not acceptance evidence.

cases.title: Honest control semantics
cases.procedure: Verify one inward 0..1 amount, zero neutral and explicit original-local-range labeling; no official range, bilateral unlock or AI claim.

cases.title: Out-of-scope controls
cases.procedure: Verify waist length, torso length and whole-body AI shaping are not marked completed or implemented by this route.

cases.title: Real body orientation
cases.procedure: Load actual admitted BodyRef v2; verify only observed shoulders11/12 and hips23/24 orient the waist field, not face-box or ratio-generated waist anatomy.

cases.title: No invented bounds
cases.procedure: Open new body: upper/lower bounds and both contours require source review; no fabricated default bounds or valid prefilled widths.

cases.title: Canonical source preview
cases.procedure: Verify editor displays bound unretouched source PNG with correct dimensions/orientation, not retouched frame or mismatched document.

cases.title: Bounds review
cases.procedure: Select separate upper and lower bounds on source; reject coincident, reversed, nonfinite and out-of-policy values.

cases.title: Independent bilateral measurements
cases.procedure: Measure visibly asymmetric sides; retain nine independent widths per side and never replace one side with the other.

cases.title: Missing side refusal
cases.procedure: Omit each side or one station in turn; active adjustment must refuse, not mirror or partially apply.

cases.title: Low-confidence anchors
cases.procedure: Reduce visibility/presence or move required actual anchor outside source; manual confirmation cannot authorize active geometry.

cases.title: Severe perspective
cases.procedure: Use side-on or strongly foreshortened torso; require refusal rather than inferred unseen boundary.

cases.title: Occluded side
cases.procedure: Use arm, bag or other occluder over one waist edge; reject unsupported contour even if other side is clear.

cases.title: Loose clothing
cases.procedure: Use loose visible shirt; editor and receipt identify visible material only and do not represent internal body anatomy.

cases.title: Unclear arm contact
cases.procedure: Use arm touching waist with ambiguous edge; refuse instead of moving arm as waist or inventing seam.

cases.title: Known other person
cases.procedure: Place another detected body inside transition support; refuse all requested waist effect before publication.

cases.title: Undetected person caution
cases.procedure: Verify review wording never claims detector census complete or no other person exists; user ownership review remains mandatory.

cases.title: Face keep-out
cases.procedure: Place retained face near transition; ensure conservative guard refuses overlap.

cases.title: Exclusion keep-out
cases.procedure: Add reviewed exclusion touching support; reject rather than shrink/crop the requested field silently.

cases.title: Ownership window
cases.procedure: Move contour or its transition beyond reviewed ownership region; reject without silently clipping evidence.

cases.title: Review isolation
cases.procedure: Attempt shoulder/leg/arm review as waist authorization; reject until waist-specific support and review exist.

cases.title: Source SHA fence
cases.procedure: Change one source byte after review, including same filename/dimensions; active preview/export must reject stale source.

cases.title: Orientation fence
cases.procedure: Change normalized orientation/source frame; reject retained support reuse.

cases.title: Pose revision fence
cases.procedure: Reanalyze same photograph; old point digest/review/support cannot be rebound automatically.

cases.title: Body ownership fence
cases.procedure: Reassign explicit anonymous person/body link; stale prepared field and receipt must not publish.

cases.title: Support content fence
cases.procedure: Mutate a width, bound, confirmation or exclusion without new digest/review; reject.

cases.title: Native neutral bypass
cases.procedure: Open, select and review with zero strength; no native deformation load, pixel change or geometry-identity churn.

cases.title: Amount validation
cases.procedure: Reject negative, greater-than-one, NaN, infinity, boolean and unknown recipe keys; no silent clamp.

cases.title: Inward direction
cases.procedure: On authorized bilateral portrait, compare source contour positions at interior stations; positive amount moves visible sides inward, not expands or changes axial length.

cases.title: Off-grid geometry
cases.procedure: Evaluate fractional coordinates across bounds; verify continuous displacement and finite values, not rounded proxy lookups.

cases.title: Support boundary identity
cases.procedure: Evaluate outside complete support and at upper/lower taper endpoints; verify exact identity and smooth transition without a seam.

cases.title: Jacobian safety
cases.procedure: Use extreme valid support and amount; shared map must refuse unsafe foldovers before publication rather than return damaged candidate.

cases.title: Budget refusal
cases.procedure: Exceed active-field/memory/displacement budget; refuse whole candidate without truncation or partial publication.

cases.title: One sampling pass
cases.procedure: Instrument later local render with shoulder+leg+arm+waist+face active; require one common source RGB sample, no per-waist resample.

cases.title: Authoritative order v4
cases.procedure: With waist active verify frozen operation order v4 is used consistently in preview, snapshot, project and export.

cases.title: Neutral order compatibility
cases.procedure: For existing shoulder-only/leg/arm documents add neutral waist intent/review; preserve prior v1/v2/v3 geometry hash and pixels.

cases.title: Existing families preservation
cases.procedure: Adjust waist with existing independent shoulders/legs/arms/hair; preserve their recipes, support, reviews and semantics.

cases.title: UI route reachability
cases.procedure: Launch exact 瘦腰 requirement from body workspace; reach real controls/source review/native view/select/execute/status, not a placeholder.

cases.title: Busy and duplicate click
cases.procedure: Rapid repeated Apply/slider releases use bounded immutable requests; no duplicate mutation or doubled amount.

cases.title: Close popup in flight
cases.procedure: Close/reopen waist dialog while request is uncertain; app-lifetime owner retains original ID and reconciles without resending.

cases.title: Stale reply after navigation
cases.procedure: Switch source/body/document before late reply; reject stale adoption and do not publish into new context.

cases.title: Lost terminal response
cases.procedure: Drop response after actual publication; original request status recovers immutable receipt and never reapplies deformation.

cases.title: Engine replacement
cases.procedure: Replace engine during pending request; native epoch fence blocks stale response and reports uncertainty rather than success.

cases.title: Cross-family request collision
cases.procedure: Reuse inner or outer request ID with different family/action/payload, including after native receipt release or epoch change; reject collision without returning misleading earlier success. Identical retained requests may query the original outcome but never execute again.

cases.title: Read-only capture stability
cases.procedure: View/select/status must not discard unrelated capture/export lifecycle or advance document content revision.

cases.title: Undo redo ownership
cases.procedure: Waist gesture undo/redo restores only intended waist changes, preserving source observations, unrelated operations and append-only support assets.

cases.title: Interrupted recovery
cases.procedure: Interrupt around journal/preview/history publication; recover explicit pending/applied/refused outcome, never fabricated publish success.

cases.title: Project14 roundtrip
cases.procedure: Save/reopen project14 with active waist and other families; validate all nested records and restore exact source-bound intent/reviews.

cases.title: Older project compatibility
cases.procedure: Open supported older project without waist; no forced stale identity or changed neutral render; preserve project compatibility behavior.

cases.title: Generic preset exclusion
cases.procedure: Save/apply generic preset on another source; waist BodyRef, contours, reviews and analysis identities are not copied.

cases.title: Batch source isolation
cases.procedure: Batch semantic workflow over distinct sources preserves existing scopes and cannot apply a source-owned waist support to another photo.

cases.title: RGB8 original export
cases.procedure: Export original-resolution RGB8; verify exact source digest/dimensions, original field rebuild, immutable actual output receipt.

cases.title: RGB16 original export
cases.procedure: Export original-resolution RGB16/high-bit source through supported path; no proxy geometry enlargement or silent source precision downgrade.

cases.title: Source changed during decode
cases.procedure: Change source during export decode; reject via stamp/digest fences, without publishing stale/mixed pixels.

cases.title: Preview export agreement
cases.procedure: Compare landmarks/contours after scaling independently rebuilt preview/export geometry; inspect final-resolution pixels and interpolation differences honestly.

cases.title: Background limitation
cases.procedure: Use straight patterned background in transition; visibly disclose it may move, inspect output and do not claim background-perfect preservation.

cases.title: Cloth texture limitation
cases.procedure: Use striped/checkered loose garment; inspect deformation, seams and details; record quality rejection when artifacts are unacceptable.

cases.title: Rotated portrait
cases.procedure: Use safely oriented rotated torso with bilateral visibility; coordinate mapping and bounds must follow actual torso direction, not fixed screen vertical.

cases.title: Package native failure
cases.procedure: Missing/wrong ABI library fails visibly on active request; no Python approximation, model download or hidden installer fallback.

cases.title: Receipt integrity
cases.procedure: Verify actual published pixel hash, prepared identity, geometry hash, dimensions and common order; request acceptance alone is not a render receipt.

cases.title: No unsupported acceptance
cases.procedure: Verify every authored case remains UNRUN with null evidence until local execution; documentation cannot promote source wiring to quality acceptance.

cases.title: ALIGN8 source-coordinate conjugation
cases.procedure: Use a full-frame ALIGN8 proxy whose x/y scale ratios differ; verify source→render coordinate conjugation maps exact reviewed source contours and bounds correctly in both axes. Compare arbitrary off-grid samples with independently scaled source-space evaluation; reject width-only isotropic approximation.

cases.title: Complete transition ownership
cases.procedure: Choose an ownership box containing all contour stations but excluding one complete transition corner; require rejection. Enlarge the box to cover complete transition support and review it explicitly before retry.

cases.title: Packaged original Rust libraries
cases.procedure: Inspect built distributor during later authorized local acceptance: arm and waist ABI outputs must both be staged at their expected paths with source/notices. Missing output cannot be hidden by stale libraries.

cases.title: Extracted family dispatch
cases.procedure: Exercise waist, leg and arm view/execute/status through body_pose_families routing; verify family protocol and immutable payload ownership stay independent and existing registered routes remain reachable.
